# Paul Cody and The Erie Riders

> Country, folk, and southern-rock singer-songwriter from Northeast Ohio (Strongsville / Cleveland area). Paul Cody fronts The Erie Riders. New 17-song double album "New Beginning" out now, with half of all profits going to veterans charities.

## Sound
Old-school storytelling blended with '70s southern rock and modern country. Voice compared to John Denver, Garth Brooks, Clint Black, Glen Campbell, Johnny Cash, and Glenn Frey.
